ASV reads 'be with the saints. Amen.' and footnotes 'Two ancient authorities read with all', which puts πάντων in the margin and τῶν ἁγίων in the text; its closing 'Amen' requires the ἀμήν that only this reading carries.

english.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all. Amen.

provenance.evidence: For the first operation v018 r01 explicitly adds Χριστοῦ after Jesus. For the second, v019 r00-base πάντων supplies the promoted all instead of baseline τῶν ἁγίων the saints. Replace those two words only and retain baseline ἀμήν, which lies outside both promoted operations. This is an explicitly scoped alternate projection, not a claim that r00-base attests the complete resulting ending with Amen. The saved KJV you all does not license adding a Greek you to the promoted English all.
